title: Sunset View Buildings
statement:
Report which buildings can see the sunset over the west horizon.

Contract
- `sunsetViews(heights)` receives non-null building heights listed from east to west.
- A building can see the sunset if every building west of it is strictly shorter.
- Equal heights block the view. Return visible building indices in increasing index order.
- Do not mutate the input list.

Examples
- Heights `[3, 7, 8, 3, 6, 1]` return `[2, 4, 5]`.
- Heights `[5, 5, 4]` return `[1, 2]` because the western `5` blocks the eastern `5`.
hints: Scan from west to east and remember the tallest building seen so far.
A building is visible exactly when its height is greater than that running maximum.
Collect indices while scanning backward, then reverse them to restore east-to-west order.
inputSyntax: Input: building heights from east to west, for example: [3, 7, 8, 3, 6, 1]
